title: The Shadow's Embrace
description: The Shadow's Embrace — The Townstons wiki
html:
The Queen of Shadows, Boss of The Shadow's Embrace
The Shadow's Embrace is recommended for levels 45 to 100. It is the ninth dungeon in the normal sequence, proceeding from The Embercore Path. It is accessible from The Shadow's Gate.

Dungeon Outline

THE SHADOW'S EMBRACE HAS BEEN RE-DONE IN VERSION 121. WE NEED YOUR HELP TO UPDATE THIS PAGE!!

Dungeon Levels Layout Mobs Mobs Attack to Use

DUNGEON DETAILS

Level 1

Forest Layout. Contains [Gos] Juggern0t!, [GoS] SHAZZAMAN, GoS spawn camper! and Poison Mutant Puker, Mutant Unipsycho.

Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom is located off Level 1.

(Demonic Crypts, formerly located here, seems to have vanished in Build 121.)

Guild of Shadows Training Chamber of Doom

Torture Chamber Layout. Contains [GoS] Angels, [GoS] Knights, GoS Reavers, [1/2] Slackers, [1/2] Blades,[1/2] Reaver. They cast curses on Attack and Defense ratings.

In order to keep the game interesting, certain information about the GoS TCoD has been omitted here. Run it and be surprised!

Level 2

Forest Layout. Contains Shadow Cave Yetti, Cave Shaman, Orok Taskmaster, and Poison Mutant Puker, Mutant Unipsycho, Mutant Pincer.

Level 3

Forest Layout. Contains Shadow Cave Yetti, Cave Shaman, Orok Taskmaster, and Poison Mutant Pincer, Mutant Puker, Mutant Unipsycho.

Obsidian Library is located off Level 3.

Obsidian Library

Ransacked Library Layout. Contains Dark Angels, Divine Angels, Divine Felknights, Shadowspawn Knights. They cast curses on Attack and Defense ratings.


Level 4

Forest Layout. Contains Shadow Cave Yetti, Cave Shaman, Orok Taskmaster, and Poison Mutant Pincer, Mutant Puker, Mutant Unipsycho.

Lava Crypts are located off Level 4.

Lava Crypts

Torture Chamber Layout. Contains Dark Angel, Shadowspawn Knight, Blood Priestess and Divine Angel, Divine Felknight, and Divine Soothsayer. They sap Attack and Defense, and come in large gangs.

Level 5

Dark Castle Layout. Contains Dark Angels, Shadowspawn Knights, and Divine Angels and Divine Knights.

Shadow Library is located off Level 5.

There are two portals on Level 5. One is the usual portal to the next dungeon, Balzack's Base Camp. The other is a portal directly to Balzack's Burrow without going through the Base Camp. The reason for this is unclear.

Shadow Library

Ransacked Library Layout. So what did you expect?? Contains Divine Whisker Shaman, Ivory Blademaster, Fire Dancer, and Crimson Spitter.

Level 6

Dark Castle Layout. Contains Dark Angels, Shadowspawn Knights, Shadowspawn Reavers, and Divine Angels and Divine Knights.


Level 7

Dark Castle Layout. Contains Dark Angels, Shadowspawn Knights, Shadowspawn Reavers, and Divine Angels and Divine Felknights.

Fade Library, Burning Fade Crypts, and the gateway to Shadow's Pinnacle are located off Level 7.

Fade Library

Ransacked Library Layout (DUH!). Contains Fire Dancers, Crimson Spitters, Embercore Seers, Divine Whisker Shaman, and Ivory Blademasters.

Burning Fade Crypts

Torture Chamber Layout. Contains Fire Dancers, Crimson Spitters, Embercore Seers, Divine Whisker Shaman, and Ivory Blademasters.

Shadow's Pinnacle

Dark Castle Layout. To each side of the portal are two chambers, each containing a Shadow Pinnacle Guardian Sarcophagus. Opening the Sarchophagus releases a Guardian Executioner and Divine Angels, Dark Angels, Shadowspawn Knights and Divine Felknights supporters. Both Executioners must be killed to open the gate. After the gate opens at the top of the stairs are more Angels and Knights, and what looks like a large stone statue. This statue is actually the Queen of Shadows, but it appears that she will not move until actually attacked. Instead she continually spawns supports, including Royal Phantasms as well as Angels and Knights.
